verdict.rationale: The RTX 5070 family page lists NVIDIA Project G-Assist as an AI assistant, powered by the RTX PC, that helps users tune, control and optimize their system. That is a first-party assistant users can hand system tasks to, but it rests on a single thin marketing line, and the 'Project' label suggests an experimental status. Missing for 10: documentation of what tasks can be delegated and how (voice, text, actions), the depth of control over the GPU or system, its availability and stability status, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: NVIDIA Project G-Assist is an AI assistant powered by your GeForce RTX PC that helps you tune, control, and optimize your system.
